/utility privacy cancella: Request deletion of your personal data.
/utility privacy esporta: Receive a copy of the data the bot holds about you.
/utility reactionsnipe: Show the last reaction removed in this channel.
/utility reminder cancel: Cancel a reminder or all your reminders.
/utility reminder server: Staff: view reminders set in this server.
/utility report: Report a user to the server staff.
/utility richiedi-comando: Suggest a new command for the bot.
/utility ruolo: Select or remove the server’s self-assignable roles.
/utility scheda anzianita: Show oldest or newest accounts and earliest or latest joins.
/utility scheda membri: Show members who have a role.
/utility scheda permessi: Show a member’s or the bot’s permissions in a channel.
/utility scheda ruoli: Show all roles with IDs, member counts and colors.
/utility scheda ruolo: Show a role’s profile: members, color, creation date and permissions.
/utility scheda server: Show the server’s profile: owner, creation date, counts and boosts.
/utility scheda utente: Show a member’s profile: ID, dates and roles.
/utility serverstats: Show server statistics: growth and channel/member activity.
/utility snipe: Show the last deleted message in this channel.
/utility suggest: Suggest an idea for this server.
/utility tag: Use a custom command from this server.
/utility verifica: Verify yourself in this server, as with the panel button.
/voice claim: Claim the channel if its owner is no longer present.
/voice deny: Prevent a user from joining the channel.
/voice invita: Send a user an invite to your channel.
/voice kick: Kick a user from your channel.
/voice lock: Lock the channel to prevent new joins.
/voice nascondi: Hide or show the channel to people who are not inside.
/voice permit: Allow a user to join even when the channel is locked.
/voice stato: Set the channel activity status (empty to remove).
